title: Self-Evaluation Improves Selective Generation in Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It focused on the model's ability to generate truthful answers to general questions (TRUTHFULQA) and the quality of summarization (TL;DR).
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study.
